vacancies.sector: Leading residential agency in the North East
vacancies.text: Your company is a leading residential agency in the North East. As part of a strategic change, the company aims to offer online housing valuation consultancy services. This includes managing a housing price valuation and forecasting app. The team is looking for a junior-level individual to support data collection, specifically focusing on housing listings and transaction information in the local area. Aside from the typical agency works, the new member will collect data from the Land Registry and comparing it with information from other regional agency competitors. The ideal candidate should possess decent numerical skills and have a basic understanding of property valuation, as their duties will include entering client housing details into the model to produce results and then explaining these outcomes to clients. The person should be a fast learner. While programming skills are not required, the candidate should be capable of maintaining regular contact with the tech support team of the valuation model.
keys: collect data from the Land Registry
comparing it with information from other regional agency competitors
entering client housing details into the model
regular contact with the tech support team
gist: The job: help an estate agency collect house-price data and run its new online valuation tool.
Who they want: a junior, quick learner who is good with numbers and knows the basics of property valuation.
Watch out: no programming is needed, but you will talk to the tech support team.
gloss: Valuation
Estimating what a property is worth.
Land Registry
The official record of who owns property and what it sold for.
Transaction data
Records of properties that have been sold, and at what price.

vacancies.sector: Student accommodation company listed on the Irish Stock Exchange
vacancies.text: You work in the asset management department in a student accommodation company that listed on Irish Stock Exchange. As the company's portfolio expands in a few major university towns, the team looks for an asset manager to cover one new submarket with some accommodations acquired from another brand, and a few newly innovated blocks. The asset manager would regularly engage with the property managers in respective buildings for operational updates. He/she will also collect the leasing information and financial performance reports for the finance team regularly. Addressing the energy efficiency goal has become one key strategy of the company recently, not only for the shareholders' expectation but also for the purpose of cutting property operating costs. The company has also been discussing installing sensor facilities in the flat shared area to monitor the electricity and water usage, where the new submarket will be a test field to evaluate the cost and benefits. The new asset manager will also be involved with the sensor facility project.
keys: regularly engage with the property managers
collect the leasing information and financial performance reports
involved with the sensor facility project
gist: The job: look after one new group of student buildings and check how well they are doing.
Who they want: someone who works well with building managers and understands leasing and finance reports.
Watch out: the company wants to cut energy use and will test sensors in your buildings.
gloss: Asset manager
Someone who looks after how a group of buildings performs as an investment.
Submarket
A smaller local area within a larger property market.
Leasing information
Details of who rents what, for how long and at what rent.
Energy efficiency
Using less energy to do the same job.

vacancies.role: Entry-level adviser for Southeast Asian investors in UK property
vacancies.text: Your company work as a financial advisor that helps High Net Worth clients from Southeast Asia invest in the UK. With more clients going overseas into the UK, your team need someone who understands both UK and Southeast Asian markets. The clients need advisory not only on where to invest a house, but usually it would involve with leasing property management, as some clients wouldn't be based in the UK. Someone at the entry-level can assist the senior manager with the daily role and client care. Travelling between countries would be common. In some cases the clients could also be interested in immigration, children's education and legal consultancy in the UK. It will be an advantage if the person knows a bit about immigration law and tax regulations, and contacts the solicitor partners when suits.
keys: High Net Worth clients from Southeast Asia
understands both UK and Southeast Asian markets
assist the senior manager with the daily role and client care
Travelling between countries would be common
gist: The job: help a senior adviser look after wealthy clients from Southeast Asia who invest in UK property.
Who they want: an entry-level person who understands both the UK and Southeast Asian markets and enjoys client care.
Watch out: lots of travel, and knowing a bit about immigration law and tax helps.
gloss: High Net Worth
People with a lot of money to invest.
Leasing and property management
Finding tenants and looking after a rented property.
Entry-level
A first job in the field, little experience needed.

vacancies.text: The Gnawtown local council is grappling with a few challenges regarding its town centre. After the COVID-19 pandemic, there has been a noticeable drop in the number of people working or just strolling on the high street. Then there's the issue of the overpowering neon lights, which used to be what the council promoted in the late 90s to attract people to the public space. But many facilities have not been appropriately maintained, and it seems they are more off-putting than inviting the local residents. The rundown buildings and the high street look even depressed with many shops closed down since the pandemic. On top of all that, the town has started to accommodate an influx of refugees in recent years, and there's a pressing need to create spaces to make both locals and the new residents feel at home. The council plans to establish a strategic team for town centre renovation. The board is seeking a planner who can help navigate these issues, transforming the town centre into an inclusive and welcoming space for all.
keys: a noticeable drop in the number of people
create spaces to make both locals and the new residents feel at home
strategic team for town centre renovation
inclusive and welcoming space for all
gist: The job: plan how to bring life back to a run-down town centre.
Who they want: a planner who can make spaces work for long-term residents and for newly arrived refugees.
Watch out: the old neon lights and empty shops are both the problem and the opportunity.
gloss: Town centre renovation
Improving the main shopping and public areas of a town.
Inclusive space
A place where different groups feel welcome and can use it.
Planner
A professional who guides how land and buildings are used.
Refugee
A person who had to leave their country for safety.

vacancies.text: The valuation team of a top-notch property consultancy firm is in a bit of a pickle. They are looking for a valuer for the hospitality branch - from swanky ones to hostels and even remote resorts. Many of these spots are in some remote areas so driving for inspection is essential. The person needs to know hotel valuation practice, but would also be able to be innovative: the recent question the team faces very often is how to value old hotel buildings that have been renovated and reach a higher energy efficiency, especially since there aren't many industry standards to lean on. So they're really hoping to find someone who's not only comfortable with the general routine, but has that spark of "research spirit". The company is willing to pay for a senior-level salary or even an associate director if the candidate is really competitive. They hope the new member not just "go by the book", but to help the team come up with guidance that could set the tone as an industry lead in hotel valuation practice in the future.
keys: how to value old hotel buildings that have been renovated
help the team come up with guidance
gist: The job: value hotels, hostels and resorts, many in remote places you have to drive to.
Who they want: an experienced person who knows hotel valuation and likes to research new methods.
Watch out: the team needs new guidance for valuing old hotels that were renovated to save energy.
gloss: Hospitality valuation
Working out the value of hotels and similar properties.
Energy efficiency
Using less energy. It can change what a building is worth.
Associate director
A senior job level in a consultancy.
Industry standard
An agreed way of doing something that most firms follow.

vacancies.role: User-needs liaison for an elderly smart-home app
vacancies.text: You are one of the founders of a PropTech startup. A recent project you are planning with the team is to develop a smart home app specially designed for vulnerable elderly people to monitor their indoor activities in their homes. It could provide convenience on remote control, indoor safety, pet feeding etc. You've been engaging a with few senior housing sites and care homes to learn the features and design, but still need to understand the real-life needs of elderly and vulnerable groups. Your colleagues, as a group of programmers, reckon there should be someone with a different background to help out, rather than all of you staying indoors brainstorming. The team hopes to find someone who can work with the property management team, have a close connection with the senior residents, and really get to the bottom of what they need. It will be great if this person also knows a bit about app development so he/she can pass it on to the programmers in a way that makes sense to them.
keys: understand the real-life needs of elderly and vulnerable groups
work with the property management team
a close connection with the senior residents
get to the bottom of what they need
knows a bit about app development
pass it on to the programmers
gist: The job: find out what older and vulnerable people really need from a smart-home app.
Who they want: someone close to older people who can work with building managers, and explain needs to programmers.
Watch out: the programmers already exist, so this is not a coding job.
gloss: PropTech
Technology that helps with property and housing.
Smart home
A home with connected devices you can control or monitor remotely.
Vulnerable
People who may need extra care or support.
Care home
A place where people live and are looked after.

vacancies.text: Your company is a global real estate investment fund that has recently completed the acquisition of a mid-sized data centre portfolio across the UK. The fund has traditionally focused on office and logistics assets, so this is its first foray into digital infrastructure. A dedicated asset management team is being formed to oversee the performance of these facilities and to work closely with the fund's technical partners and tenants, ranging from cloud-service providers to AI computing firms. As the fund explores a "green digital" investment strategy, the asset manager will contribute to identifying and evaluating efficiency technologies (e.g. liquid cooling or renewable-powered systems) and translating technical outcomes into financial impacts. A main challenge is to get someone who understands the "business": existing members from the investment and real estate background don't know much beyond tenancy structures and service-charge budgets, while the key performance indicators like power usage effectiveness (PUE), uptime, and other sustainability compliance remain crucial when liaising with the fund's ESG and investment teams on retrofit opportunities. The team is looking for someone who has the capacities to bridge real-estate and infrastructure knowledge -- ideally with experience in high-spec commercial or industrial buildings, solid financial modelling skills, and curiosity about the fast-changing digital economy.
keys: oversee the performance of these facilities
work closely with the fund's technical partners and tenants
translating technical outcomes into financial impacts
liaising with the fund's ESG and investment teams
curiosity about the fast-changing digital economy
gist: The job: manage a new portfolio of data centres for an investment fund.
Who they want: someone who can link property with technology and turn technical results into money terms.
Watch out: you must understand data-centre measures such as PUE and uptime.
gloss: Data centre
A building full of computers that store and process data.
PUE (power usage effectiveness)
A score of how efficiently a data centre uses electricity. Closer to 1 is better.
Uptime
How much of the time the system is running without failure.
ESG
Environmental, social and governance: ways to judge how responsibly a company behaves.
Retrofit
Upgrading an existing building with new equipment.
